description: Plan, conduct, compare, and synthesize web research with transparent sources and uncertainty.

defaultPrompt: Research this topic and cite the strongest sources.
Compare the evidence and explain disagreements.
Create a concise research brief with links.
interface.longDescription: Web Research Assistant turns an open-ended topic into a structured research report. It frames the question, finds relevant sources, evaluates source quality and recency, compares claims, identifies conflicts and evidence gaps, and presents findings with direct citations and clearly labeled uncertainty.

name: web-research-assistant
